references: e: Gayer et al. (2008) (temperature dependent; the room-temperature coefficients are verified, the temperature coefficient b4 = 1.516e-4 could not be cross-checked -- pyNLO uses 1.526e-5); o: congruent LiNbO3, Zelmon, Small & Jundt, JOSA B 14, 3319 (1997); d33 = 25 pm/V
